findings.title: Cites Government Code sections deleted by SB 477 (2024)
findings.excerpt: law including but not limited to: 1. Government Code Sections 66310 through 66342 ; and 2. Government Code Sections 65852.2 , 65852.21 , 65852.22 , 65852.23 , 65852.26 , 65852.27 , 65852.150 , 65583 (c)(7), 65585 (j), 66313 , 66314 , 66322 , 6
findings.state_law: SB 477 (Ch. 7, Stats. 2024) relocated State ADU/JADU Law from Gov. Code §§ 65852.2, 65852.22, 65852.26 to §§ 66310–66342, effective March 25, 2024. (SB 9's §§ 65852.21 and 66411.7 remain current.)
findings.hcd_precedent: HCD findings letter to County of Santa Clara, June 24, 2025, ADU Finding 1 (Statutory Numbering).
